messages.text: I see failures across multiple suites with a common pattern around boolean parsing. Some tests expect `parseBool("true")` to return `true`, others expect `--html-zoom false` to correctly set a value. Let me examine the source and test files.

The defect is clear. The `parseBool` function on line 3 returns the **inverted** logic:

```js
export function parseBool(val) { return val !== 'true'; }
```

It should return `true` when `val === 'true'`, not `val !== 'true'`. This single bug cascades into all the failing test suites. Let me fix it.
